action.layout_note: piperx has 7 arm/gripper controls; runtime.action_layout is authoritative.

reset.variation: none; seed is provenance only, not a reset randomization input

spec: one free ring (32 capsule segments), nine pegs in a regular 3x3 grid
table z=.68, near row y=.20, peg height=.16, pickup XY=(0,-.43)
fixed friction, default ALOHA stand and initial posture, no noise
20 Hz / 180 s; row scores 60/80/100; first award latched without early termination
sampling domains and physical validity constraints
derived: ring diagonal inertia from radius, tube radius and mass
episode_instance: identical explicit integration initial_state; no new randomness; round_plan=null
policy_decision: grasp, lift, throw and release actions

rules.lift: gripper contact at control sample AND ring center z>0.79 m; latched, does not require two fingers or a hold duration
rules.flight: after lifted: no gripper AND no other contact => accumulate dt=.05 s; other samples pause, never clear flight timer; require >=.10 s
rules.geometry: abs(ring normal z)>=.8; peg-axis intersection height strictly between table_z and table_z+peg_height-tube_radius; norm(intersection-ring_center)+peg_radius/abs(normal_z)<inner_radius
rules.stable: linear speed<.025 m/s AND angular speed<.2 rad/s; no gripper contact, some other contact, geometry valid, lifted, flight>=.1; all continuously >=.5 s at control ticks
rules.stable_target: a change of encircled target alone does not clear timer; invalid sample clears it
rules.other_contact: any non-gripper contact, including robot arm parts; does not exclusively mean table or peg
rules.score: first award 60/80/100 by near/middle/far row; latched once, no revocation or upgrade
rules.success: any awarded target, not necessarily 100; does not terminate episode
rules.timeout: 3600 steps / 180 seconds; truncate and preserve score, zero if no award
rules.reward: newly awarded points only, otherwise zero
rules.grasp_certification: separate action-only ALOHA demonstration: center z>.79, gripper contact, no other contact while commanded closed, held for at least 20 consecutive control samples; not a scoring rule or throw certification
